property_summary: For any fresh eligible (Bank) caller whose prior airDrop attempts by others have already settled—whether they succeeded or reverted—the reentrancy lock must be released so that caller's airDrop succeeds; the mutant never releases the lock after a reverting (hasNoBalance) airDrop, leaving the lock stuck and making the fresh caller's airDrop revert for some inputs.
change_summary: Remove the unlock statement so the lock is never released and subsequent airDrop calls revert.
